notes.text: Friday was stopped early by severe weather (reported by the press at about 9:00 PM; Ultra's own archived pages carry no notice), so the sets printed for 9:00 PM or later on the Friday grid are not listed. Ultra re-issued the Saturday grid as a complete schedule, and it lists several of those Friday acts on Saturday.
